profile.headline: Probably Not a Bot
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer and data scientist. I tend to do my best work interfacing between engineering and analytics teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Senior Data Scientist
positions.description: Applied a variety of analytic methods to quantify autonomous vehicle performance. Implemented infrastructure to monitor and report on performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Implemented data pipelines and reports for Office 365. Built additional infrastructure to support the lake and end user consumption of the data. Drove improvements in engineering practices, including improved release processes, adherence to security standards, and source control. 

Highlights: 
• Served as scrum master. Worked with program managers to understand business requirements. Ensured the team had sufficient technical documentation and clarity before starting new development work. Drove completion and planning for prioritized features.
• Overhauled our reporting API to improve performance and speed up development cycles. Reduced data refresh times from 10 minutes to less than 10 seconds for 90% of metrics. Automated refresh scheduling, error logging, and caching, allowing developers to focus on data transformation logic.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Power BI · SQL · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Lead Data Scientist / Lead Technical Analyst
positions.description: Completed work on client projects, with a focus in statistics and data science. Supported the sales team in scoping and selling new projects. Team lead with four direct reports.

positions.title: Consultant, Analytics
positions.description: Completed work on client projects, with a focus on database development and business intelligence.

positions.title: Agricultural Statistican
positions.description: Used a variety of statistical methods to calibrate lab instruments and improve test accuracy.  Streamlined and automated analyses and report generation.
